title: Senior Manager, Content & Brand (CAN/USA)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Manager, Content & Brand

 Level: M3 |
Location: CAN/USA | Remote
Reports To: Michael Scott, Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

Type: Permanent | Full-Time

The Role

At Solink, our mission is to safeguard what matters most. We provide businesses with the tools to know sooner and act faster by transforming video into real-time operational insights. Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments — empowering teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency. Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries, including brands like McDonald's and JYSK, Solink delivers clarity when it counts.

Solink is looking for a Senior Manager, Content & Brand to build the narrative and content engine that establishes Solink as the leader of our category — and to arm our Sales and Marketing teams with the content assets that drive demand. You'll own our category point of view, our educational thought-leadership content, and our speaker & influencer program, turning Solink's expertise into content the market seeks out.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can set a brand narrative, build a content program around it, and lead a team (plus a network of freelancers/agencies) to ship on a consistent cadence.

What You'll Be Doing

Category & Brand Narrative

  • Define and maintain Solink's category narrative and brand point of view, in partnership with Product Marketing and executive stakeholders.

  • Commission or produce original research and data-driven thought leadership (e.g., industry benchmark reports, trend studies) that positions Solink as the category authority.

Content Strategy & Editorial Calendar

  • Build and manage an editorial calendar covering owned channels (blog, LinkedIn, newsletter),, and owned executive channels (speaking, podcasts).

  • Set the quality bar and editorial standards across the content program.

Speaker & Influencer Program

  • Run the trade-focused speaker and influencer program end-to-end: prospecting and vetting speakers/influencers, securing speaking slots and partnerships, briefing spokespeople, and measuring reach and pipeline impact.

  • Manage Solink executives, customers, and external partners/analysts as speakers, panelists, and content collaborators at relevant trade events.

Sales & Marketing Enablement

  • Partner with Sales and Demand Gen to turn thought-leadership content into enablement assets — battlecards, social proof points, webinar content, and campaign copy.

  • Convert content into usable assets (talk tracks, one-pagers, social content, sales decks) that reps and campaigns can deploy directly.

Team & Vendor Management

  • Manage a content team and/or a network of freelance writers, designers, and agencies.

  • Manage budget for content production, speaker fees/sponsorships, and influencer partnerships.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Own content performance measurement (engagement, share of voice, pipeline influence) and report against goals to marketing leadership.

A Little Bit About You

  • 7+ years in content marketing, brand marketing, or content strategy roles, including B2B SaaS or a comparable technical category.

  • 2+ years of direct people management or managing a mixed team of employees, freelancers, and agencies.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a brand or category narrative, and experience turning it into a sustained content program (not a single campaign).

  • Experience building or running a speaker, analyst, or influencer program (conferences, paid podcasts, partner co-marketing).

  • Strong editorial judgment and hands-on writing/editing ability; comfortable both setting strategy and producing content directly when needed.

  • Track record partnering closely with Sales and/or Demand Gen to convert content into pipeline-supporting assets.

Role Expectations

This is an M3 level role — Solink's Senior Manager archetype. At Solink, individuals at this level are key leaders within their department: they effectively manage their team, provide strategic guidance on organizational initiatives and priorities, set direction independently, and execute at a high level.

In this role, you'll be expected to:

  • Lead large-scale projects and initiatives that have an impact on the organization, while keeping Solink's strategy and goals top of mind.

  • Operate with very little supervision and a high level of autonomy.

  • Lend a strong voice in developing the strategic goals of Marketing and the broader organization.

  • Drive, manage, and make decisions on overall content and brand prioritization and execution within the agreed strategy.

  • Develop and mentor your team members (and manage freelancers/agencies) to achieve team and career goals.

  • Manage the work of leads and/or senior contributors across multiple stakeholders — Sales, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, and executive spokespeople.

  • Identify goals and scope the team's work, and hold the team accountable for its output.

  • Proactively resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts, and champion adoption of new content and brand processes.

What success looks like:

  • Content & Brand is recognized as a strategic partner to Sales and Demand Gen, not an on-demand content shop.

  • The narrative, editorial calendar (e.g., blogs, assets), and speaker/influencer program you build operate on a predictable cadence and outlast any single campaign.

  • Your team — direct reports, freelancers, and agencies — is developing toward the next level, with clear ownership and accountability.

Key Outcomes:

  • A published, cross-functionally adopted category narrative and messaging framework.

  • A running content engine (editorial calendar, production pipeline) shipping on a consistent cadence.

  • A launched speaker & influencer program with a defined roster and a first cohort of secured placements.

  • Documented lift in share of voice/category association and in Sales-reported use of content assets in deals.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience in physical security, loss prevention, retail operations, or another category with a strong operations/data angle.

  • Experience commissioning or producing original research/data studies as thought-leadership content.

  • Familiarity with content and social analytics tooling, and comfort reporting content performance in business terms (pipeline, share of voice) rather than vanity metrics.

Security Requirements

  • Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  • Be a Canadian or American Citizen, or eligible to work in Canada or the United States.

  • Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

Our Values

We do things the Solink way:

  • Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

  • Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

  • Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

  • Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.

Why Solink?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

  • Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

  • Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

  • Comprehensive benefits: A stellar benefits package, ensuring you're fully supported with anything you need.

  • Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

  • Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

  • Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

  • Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

  1. Intro call with our Talent Team

  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  4. Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  5. Reference Checks

  6. Offer & onboarding 🎉

Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.

NOTICE: Solink uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position.

Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.
